items.criterion: The 200D MA of relative price flat or falling over the month, read each Friday

bullets.text: For a Core Investment this would be a sell signal; Fevertree is a Probing Bet, so the 10-day stop-loss rule decides the sale.

At a flat relative price it reads (0.26%) on 6-Nov and (0.41%) on 13-Nov; clearing 13-Nov needs closes of about 1,049p from 6-Nov.
